name: Gravewick Mayhem
description: Tag-team cartoon brawler: swap between Grimble the reaper and his apprentices Pip and Wisp to smash underworld monsters and bosses.
tips: Press Q or 1-2-3 to swap heroes.
New monsters fill your Grimoire. Press G to read it.
Hits fill the ultimate meter. Press L to unleash it.
Shift dashes through attacks. Chain 3 hits to finish.
Pip’s Gadget Pouch throws bouncing dynamite, frost or shock bombs.
